test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three bells A, B and C toll every 15 seconds, 24 seconds, and 42 seconds, respectively. If all of them toll together at 8 a.m., then between 8 a.m. and 10 a.m. on the same day, how many times will they all toll together, including the one at 8 a.m.?
solution:
**Given:**

Bell A tolls every 15 seconds.

Bell B tolls every 24 seconds.

Bell C tolls every 42 seconds.

**Formula Used:**

Number of times they toll together = Total Time / LCM of intervals

**Calculation:**

LCM of 15, 24, and 42

Prime factorization:

15 = 3 × 5

24 = 2³ ×
